title: 0 — First vertical slice
description: Run the local simulation end to end.

issues.title: Review and accept the first slice
issues.body: Run the demo and tests. Trace one event through all six documented components. Change the simulator speed and explain the effect. Acceptance: James can explain the flow and its crash limitations. Current starter implements the path; this issue tracks human review.

title: 1 — Reproducible replay and measurements
description: Prove correctness and establish a performance baseline before distribution.

issues.title: Add strict JSONL telemetry replay
issues.body: Parse external event fields strictly; reject unknown versions, missing fields and bad types. Add a 20-car fixture and configurable replay speed. Acceptance: repeated replay produces identical final state; malformed events are reported without invented readings.

issues.title: Measure local latency and freshness
issues.body: Measure queue depth, ingestion lag and API p50/p95 at 200 events/sec. Acceptance: publish machine details and observed results against 100 ms API p95 / 500 ms display-age targets; document failures rather than assuming success.

title: 2 — Postgres and worker processes
description: Complete the distributed MVP with one state owner and durable replay.

issues.title: Persist events and latest state in Postgres
issues.body: Add explicit SQL migrations and a small repository interface. Use unique event keys and guarded latest-state upserts in one transaction. Acceptance: duplicates are idempotent; late events are retained in history without rollback; restart restores the same state.

issues.title: Run two validation worker processes
issues.body: Add bounded process queues and a single coordinator/state writer. Acceptance: out-of-order completion cannot roll back state; browser works through Postgres-backed snapshots; document that in-flight crash recovery is deferred.

issues.title: Verify the distributed MVP end to end
issues.body: Replay 20 cars through two workers, Postgres, API and browser. Acceptance: deterministic final state, coherent snapshots, responsive layout, selected-driver persistence, visible disconnect/staleness and published latency measurements.

title: 3 — Recovery and containers
description: Make failure behavior deliberate and reproducible.

issues.title: Implement heartbeats, leases and task reassignment
issues.body: Add durable task ledger, lease generations, heartbeat expiry, bounded retries and dead-letter handling. Acceptance: kill a worker in flight; replacement completes its task; stale owners cannot commit; restart does not lose acknowledged work.

issues.title: Containerize the application and Postgres
issues.body: Add Dockerfiles and Compose only after process commands are stable. Acceptance: clean-machine startup, persistent volume, migrations, health/readiness distinction and documented graceful shutdown.

issues.title: Test database and coordinator failures
issues.body: Inject database disconnects and coordinator restarts. Acceptance: no acknowledged event loss; duplicate retries are safe; backpressure stays bounded; recovery window is measured.

title: 4 — Analytics and verified feeds
description: Add history without slowing the live path.

issues.title: Export Parquet and analyze with DuckDB
issues.body: Export immutable events partitioned by session. Acceptance: schema/row counts match Postgres and an example SQL analysis runs without querying the live state path.

issues.title: Evaluate and integrate one real telemetry source
issues.body: Verify current feed access, terms, latency, identifiers and coordinate mappings before choosing a provider. Acceptance: documented provenance and limits, adapter contract tests, replay fixture and explicit live/delayed labeling.

title: 5 — Context, customization and deployment
description: Add useful fan context and operate a measured product.

issues.title: Add sourced news and social context
issues.body: Evaluate API access and usage terms first. Store source URL, publication time, fetch time and dedupe key. Acceptance: attribution and stale labels; no context item can mutate telemetry.

issues.title: Add panel customization and deploy
issues.body: Allow users to hide/reorder panels with local preferences. Choose a host and add HTTPS, request limits, secrets, backups and monitoring. Acceptance: measured browser latency and restore drill; profile before any Go rewrite.
